title: Sanatsal Yaratılcılık ve Duygudurum Bozukluğu
author: Cem Mumcu
description: Cem Mumcu explores the intricate link between artistic creativity and emotional fluctuations, presenting a rare resource that bridges art, science, and mental health. Drawing on empirical research as well as philosophy, literature, and modern psychiatry, he offers a holistic perspective on the complex relationship between creativity and mood. Accessible yet profound, this book serves not only academics but also general readers seeking to understand the fragile, dynamic world of artistic production.
